replacement_observations: Two stepped hose nipples, two mounting ears and rectangular two-blade connector.
Cap lower skirt has axial slots and circumferential seam, visible particularly Bac and Con.
Slots are consistent with compliant skirt but do not expose hidden latch, groove, press fit, seal or retention load.
No visible screw threads or metal crimp; absence from external views is not proof of assembly method.
Connector closeups show separate insulating terminal recesses; cannot infer coil termination.
patent_comparison: Fig2 positive-gain design has source restriction, common source/output mixing chamber, movable disc at atmospheric seat, bias spring, coil/stator, filter and magnetic shell. Fig3 is a separate negative-gain design, not to combine. No measured dimensions or calibration transferred.
applicability: Exact1994PCED supports coil/armature/disc/orifice mechanism; exact1994DN supports filtered atmosphere. Patent supplies comparative complete arrangement only. Actual part identity and hidden construction remain unknown.
access_limits: Direct Standard catalog and two other catalog pages returned403; original five manufacturer filenames remain not independently inspected. Retailer photographs provide replacement comparison.
Adjacent1992 Ford image request timed out; existing reviewed text retained, no unseen image claim.
proposed_topology: Lower source nipple -> estimated restrictor -> chamber also connected to upper EGR nipple.
Atmosphere -> cap slots -> filter -> hollow core -> disc-controlled opening to common chamber.
Disc moves away from core to vent; seats against core to close atmospheric path.
Illustrative bias spring under disc, coil/bobbin around core, magnetic return shell and two isolated terminal connections.
Cap slotted-skirt retention may be modeled as explicit illustrative snap capture; factory latch/groove unknown.
required_controls: Source-to-output continuous in both disc poses.
Atmosphere-to-chamber open with disc lifted, blocked with disc seated.
Blocked source restrictor, stuck disc and filter bypass controls.
Disc seat contact, spring support and whole-stroke collision controls.
Electrical continuity/isolation controls without invented resistance.
Cap pull-off capture, wrong-position and interference checks.
